title: TIE: your card filing checklist
intro: Use this for the physical TIE step once you have the visa, residence/stay authorization or favorable decision that supports your card. The TIE documents an existing legal status; it does not create that status by itself.
status: National Police procedure · appointment labels and supporting-document checks can vary

items.label: Procedure
items.text: Solicitud de Tarjeta de Identidad de Extranjero (TIE) — form EX-17 for the card-issuance step. Confirm that your underlying authorization or status is already in place.

items.label: Where to go
items.text: The TIE application is handled in person through the competent Oficina de Extranjería or Policía Nacional office for the procedure. Follow the office shown for your province and appointment.

items.label: What to select
items.text: In the appointment system, choose the TIE / fingerprinting (toma de huellas) option offered for your card type and province. Do not select NIE assignment or EU-citizen registration instead; wording can differ between offices.

items.label: Forms and fee
items.text: Prepare EX-17 and proof of payment of Modelo 790, código 012 for the applicable TIE card line. Check the current official fee and the line that matches your card before paying.

items.label: Bring
bullets: Valid passport or travel document required for your case
Proof of payment of Modelo 790 código 012
Your favorable resolution, visa or other evidence of the authorization/status supporting the TIE, as applicable
Any photograph, address evidence or additional documents required by the Police office for your specific card type

items.label: What happens after
items.text: The Police complete the identification/card-issuance step and give you the instructions for collection or the next step. Follow the collection instructions from that office; the TIE reflects the validity of the underlying authorization.
